title: Dashboard force-sell and emergency-sell are sent as a routine exit, so a position whose routine retries are paused cannot be sold from the dashboard, even though the pause alert tells the operator to act manually

evidence.note: force-sell calls executeFullSell with reason urgency-market-sell
executeFullSell skips any non-anti-rug reason when isRoutinePaused, before the sell lock, returning false
the pause is set after EXIT_ROUTINE_MAX_FAILURES consecutive failures; the alert says "inspect the position ... and resume manually"
routinePausedPositions is an in-memory Set; it is cleared only by a genuine close (:674); there is no resume or override path in the slice
false is reported as 409 "Sell already in progress for this position", which is wrong here; the timers were already cleared at :92

sibling_sites_checked: Both dashboard sell routes (controls.ts force-sell :96-104, emergency-sell :169-177) and the pause check (:824-830). The success-still-held path (:1110) and the inconclusive path (:995) leave the buy row pending, so those positions are selectable by the dashboard but then refused by the pause; positions failed through the catch are marked failed (:1163) and are not selectable at all, which is the ESC-PRE-04 sibling owned by 22-22 (key:API:failed-held-sell-selection). The two gaps together mean a paused position cannot be sold from the dashboard either way. The only exits left are anti-rug (bypasses the pause) or a restart.
severity_rationale: S1. Proven by the code. The plausible condition is the one the pause is built for: five failed routine exits on a still-held position (a sell-reverting token, a relay outage). The bot then tells the operator to act manually, and the dashboard controls refuse with a misleading "already in progress". Not S0 because anti-rug still fires and a restart lifts the pause for one more attempt.
recommendation: Give operator sells their own reason that bypasses the routine pause (as anti-rug does), report the real reason a sell did not run, and offer an explicit resume. Card EXIT-07. Phase 24 together with the ESC-PRE-04 fix.
